profile.ja: 魔界に住む鬼族の娘。いつも元気いっぱいで遊ぶことが大好き。成長するにつれて戦いのスリルと興奮を覚え、誰彼構わず遊びという名の勝負を持ちかけるようになった。鬼族としては未熟だが、それでも人間を遥かに凌ぐ腕力と、雷を自在に操る魔力を持つ。最近はもっぱら人間界を訪れては、興味を持った人間に勝負を挑んでいる。彼女が本気を出せば鍛えた男性相手でも楽に勝ててしまうが、彼女は戦いを楽しむために、あえて鬼の力を抑えたり、相手に勝負方法を決めさせたりして五分の勝負を楽しめるように工夫している。
profile.en: A daughter of the demon tribe living in the Demon Realm. She is always bursting with energy and loves to play. As she grew up, she began to relish the thrill and excitement of battle, challenging anyone to a contest under the guise of play. Though still inexperienced as a demon, she possesses strength far surpassing that of humans and can freely manipulate lightning. Lately she has been frequenting the Human Realm, issuing challenges to any humans who catch her interest. When she goes all-out, she can easily defeat even well-trained men, but she deliberately holds back her demon power or lets her opponent decide the terms so that she can enjoy a close-fought, five-minute showdown.

text.ja: 私と遊んでくれるの？　やったぁー！　私、クレハ。い～～～っぱい、遊ぼうね！
text.en: You'll play with me? Yay! I'm Kureha. Let's have a ton of fun!

text.ja: 本ばっかり読んでないでさ、今日も元気に、勝負勝負♪
text.en: Don't just read books all the time—let's be energetic today too, battle battle♪

text.ja: お菓子くれるの？　やったー！　じゃあそれ、勝負に勝ったごほうびね！
text.en: You'll give me sweets? Yay! Then that'll be the prize for winning the match!

text.ja: そおしゃるゲームぅ？　おおっ、やったことないけどおもしろそう！
text.en: A… a… "so-sharu" game? Oh, I've never tried it but it sounds fun!

text.ja: おーっ！　遊ぼう！　今日はどこ行く？　何する？　楽しみだな～♪
text.en: Ooo! Let's play! Where shall we go today? What shall we do? I'm so excited~♪

text.ja: 戦いに行くの？　じゃあ私もついてくー！　強い人いるかな～、わくわく♪
text.en: Going to a fight? Then I'll come too! I wonder if there'll be strong people, I'm thrilled~

text.ja: ねえねえ私と遊ばない？　勝負しよ、勝負♪
text.en: Hey hey, won't you play with me? Let's have a match, match♪

text.ja: 勝負に負けたらバツゲームね。ん？　私に勝ったら？　じゃあなんでも言うこと聞いてあげるよ
text.en: If I lose the match, it's a penalty game. Huh? If you beat me? Then I'll do anything you say.
